findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] alternative-mitigation-accepted: GET /orders/{order_id} builds the lookup as owned_by(db.query(Order), Order, current_user).filter(Order.id == order_id).first(), so ownership is a predicate in the WHERE clause rather than a comparison after loading; another customer's row is never materialized. A miss raises HTTPException(404) rather than 403, so identifier tampering cannot confirm existence. owned_by (apis/auth/utils/authz.py:175-188) centralizes the rule and exempts only holders of READ_DELIVERY_FEED. The route additionally requires Permission.READ_OWN_ORDERS. No residual fetch-by-primary-key-then-check pattern found. | verdict=pass confidence=high
